{{Youmay|the New Republic Intelligence community|[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Intelligence community (Galactic Alliance)|Intelligence community]]}}
'''Intelligence community''' was a term used to describe the combined intelligence apparatus of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. It included the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] and [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] and [[Officer/Legends|officers]] were called "members" of the intelligence community when their individual branches were not identified.
